title: Use saved files as the KiCad 10 synchronization boundary
rationale: Supported KiCad 10 interfaces cannot prove unsaved Schematic, Symbol, or Footprint Editor state. Scan after saves, label results as last-saved state, never modify an open design behind KiCad, and use guided native replacement or a guarded closed-project transform. Defer library activation until KiCad closes when editor cleanliness is unknown.

title: Render symbol and footprint previews with the installed kicad-cli
rationale: Previews are SVGs from `kicad-cli sym export svg` and `kicad-cli fp export svg`, which use KiCad's own drawing code. KiCad's preview panes can't be embedded in another app. Find kicad-cli in standard install locations or a user override. Cache SVGs by library content hash and KiCad version. Measured on KiCad 10.0.4: about 0.25 s per part.

description: kicad-cli 10.0.4 `fp export svg` exits 0 even when it writes nothing, and needs its output directory to exist. It loads the whole .pretty to export one footprint: about 0.5 s warm and 2.2 s cold for KiCad's Package_SO.
resolution: Count an export as done only if the expected SVG exists; otherwise report stdout and stderr. Create the output directory first. Export from a temporary one-footprint .pretty, with --theme _builtin_default. Reject names starting with '-', which kicad-cli reads as options. See crates/kicad-integration/src/preview.rs.

title: Export kicad-cli previews lazily, one item per cache miss
rationale: On a cache miss, export only the selected symbol, with every unit and De Morgan body, or the selected footprint. The first view waits about 0.3-0.6 s; later views read the cache. Exporting all 35 libraries took about 11 s, so whole-library export would delay first use. Key the cache by library SHA-256, KiCad version and theme.

title: Share preview exports, run two at most, and drop replaced requests
rationale: PreviewCache in crates/kicad-integration/src/preview/ shares one export per cache entry and runs two kicad-cli exports at most. Each request carries a selection number, and exports that only older selections want are dropped. Eviction moves folders to trash before deleting them. Team parts draw the stored bytes of their exact CAD item revision, after hash checks.

name: KiCad database libraries and placed symbols
description: Checked 2026-10-10. A database library row points to Library:Symbol and optionally Library:Footprint, with no revision. It can map 0/1 columns to exclude_from_bom, exclude_from_board and exclude_from_sim. Schematics keep their own copy of each placed symbol. Source: https://docs.kicad.org/10.0/en/eeschema/eeschema.html

title: Each part revision gets its own KiCad library entry
rationale: Decided 2026-10-10, built 2026-10-17 in crates/kicad-libraries (kicad-parts-f397). KiCad fetches updates by the stored entry name, so a name without the revision would pull in newer CAD. Entries are named like RES-0000-0470_v2; the IPN field and the BOM keep the plain IPN, and Revision has its own field. Layout: mx-a97f8c.

title: Group parts by category, footprints by package, 3D models with footprints
rationale: Decided 2026-10-11 (kicad-parts-f397, kicad-parts-ae44), built 2026-10-17. Each category is one KiCad chooser group. Footprint libraries use KiCad's package groups with the team code, such as MA-Resistor_SMD, because one package serves many categories; 3D models go beside them in MA-Resistor_SMD.3dshapes. globally_unique_keys is on from the first release; turning it on later breaks schematic links.

name: Library index and its cache
description: catalog-browser src/libraries reads every library on three threads into memory and caches one JSON file per library in <cache>/library-index/v1. A library is read again only when its sizes or times change. KiCad 10 reads in about 1 s warm, 0.3 s from cache, about a minute on a cold disk. Tests pass fixture tables, never the person's settings.
kicad-cli 10 cannot read a .kicad_symdir library: sym export svg says the file does not exist.
resolution: Draw a symdir symbol as stored bytes: its entry after the parents it extends. PreviewCache accepts that chain (preview.rs write_symbol_library).

description: Treating every Windows reparse point as a link would skip OneDrive online-only files, which many people's KiCad libraries are.
resolution: Outside our libraries, count only symbolic links and junctions (Rust's is_symlink). Our libraries keep the library check's stricter rule. See catalog-browser src/libraries/sources.rs.

description: kicad-cli loads and saves the person's KiCad settings. When it reads kicad_common.json while another KiCad process saves it, it saves defaults over the whole file. That empties their path variables. Running several kicad-cli at once did this on 2026-10-15.
resolution: Start kicad-cli only through run_kicad_cli with a CliSettingsFolder of our own. It sets KICAD_CONFIG_HOME and KICAD_CACHE_HOME there. Pass any path variable with --define-var, never through the person's settings.

title: The app opens network models only through a path variable
rationale: Windows may send the person's sign-in to a network host a model link names. So the 3D view and model copying open only drive paths, or folders from path variables the person set. A one-slash path opens only if, made absolute, it lands on a drive letter. KiCad opens network links; we refuse them on purpose. Rule: openable_path in model3d.rs.

title: Resolve catalog library references only in LibraryResolver
rationale: crates/kicad-integration/src/resolver.rs turns a reference such as g-res:R_US into a library file on disk. It owns where libraries live and the order they are searched, so callers pass only the reference and never repeat that logic. 3D model links have their own order in crates/catalog-browser/src/model3d.rs. The Python-era plan to put copying and 3D assets here was never built.

description: KiCad 10 could not load a .kicad_dbl whose connection string said DRIVER={SQLite3}. kicad-cli ERC only said the library 'was not found at' its path; no ODBC error was shown.
resolution: Name the driver exactly as Windows lists it under HKLM ODBCINST.INI: DRIVER={SQLite3 ODBC Driver}. kicad_libraries::odbc::DRIVER holds the name; the real KiCad test in tooling/local-team/tests/kicad_libraries.rs proves it loads.

title: One team database library: category groups plus shared older and archived groups
rationale: kicad-parts-f397, 2026-10-17. With globally_unique_keys, KiCad links CODE-Parts:ENTRY and tries every table, so a row can move groups without breaking links. KiCad hides only whole libraries, so archived revisions stay visible. It reads the .kicad_dbl once, so every table is always listed. One group has one field list, so the shared older and archived groups hold only shared fields.

name: Proving KiCad resolves library links with kicad-cli
description: kicad-cli sch erc with a project sym-lib-table reports lib_symbol_mismatch for a found entry whose saved copy differs, and lib_symbol_issues 'not found' otherwise; that works for .kicad_dbl entries. kicad-cli pcb drc runs the library parity check: lib_footprint_issues names a missing footprint. KiCad's library dialogs take pasted (sym_lib_table ...) text.

name: KiCad 10 database libraries, from its source
description: Read 2026-10-17 in KiCad 10.0 sch_io_database.cpp: globally_unique_keys links LIB:KEY, and LoadSymbol tries every table. A thread rereads rows every cache.max_age seconds; we set 10. The .kicad_dbl is read once per load, while .kicad_sym and .pretty files reload when they change. Each table is a chooser group, and empty ones still show.

name: KiCad libraries from the Catalog: crates/kicad-libraries
description: kicad-parts-f397. plan.rs works out files and rows from the records alone. update writes footprint, model and symbol files, then the SQLite rows in one transaction, then the .kicad_dbl. Written files are checked by putting stored names and links back, never rewritten, so only missing blobs are downloaded. catalog-browser kicad_libraries/team.rs runs it on one thread per team (f10d).

KiCad 10 reads every symbol in a .kicad_sym by the file's version. With the newest version as the header, older symbols' ~ texts (empty before 20250318) would show as ~. A symbol newer than 20251024 makes KiCad refuse the whole file.
resolution: Write one symbol library per CAD library and file version, such as MA-res-20241209. Leave out symbols newer than NEWEST_SYMBOL_VERSION in crates/kicad-libraries/src/plan.rs.

name: KiCad footprint libraries are writable if their folder is
description: KiCad 10 checks whether a .pretty folder can be written, not its files (pcb_io_kicad_sexpr.cpp 105, 3674-3680). A read-only footprint file only stops saving over it (line 3495). People can still save new footprints into our folders, so each update reports files the Catalog does not make.

In a saved schematic copy, KiCad writes a space inside a footprint filter as {space}, because ki_fp_filters splits on spaces. A copy with a plain space gave lib_symbol_mismatch for a footprint named 'QFN77-48LD-PL-1 (MICROCHIP)'.
resolution: Write each filter with spaces as {space}, as tests/support/kicad.rs saved_copy does. A symbol that extends another cannot be copied by hand; expect a mismatch for it.

description: kicad-cli sch erc reads the project's sym-lib-table only when the schematic has a .kicad_pro of the same name beside it. A second sheet in the same folder said 'The current configuration does not include the symbol library'.
resolution: Give each checked schematic its own folder with check.kicad_pro, check.kicad_sch and sym-lib-table.

description: KiCad 10.0.7 builds each database entry as the database library loads (issue 25870, opened by lukas-runge 2026-10-21, fork fix proposed, not fixed in 10.0.8-rc1). An entry whose symbol library is still loading gets an empty symbol. ERC then says lib_symbol_mismatch.
resolution: Partly worked around in kicad-parts-bd98: team libraries load first (setup.rs). Parts using KiCad's own symbols stay affected, because pasted rows sit above KiCad's: 20 false mismatches on the full catalog. Desktop heals within cache.max_age, 10 s in our .kicad_dbl. Tests set MaximumThreads=1.

description: kicad-cli sym upgrade and fp upgrade write CRLF line ends on Windows, so fixture files made with them differed from git's copy and between computers.
resolution: Turn CRLF into LF after kicad-cli writes; the repo's .gitattributes then keeps LF. Run kicad-cli with KICAD_CONFIG_HOME, KICAD_CACHE_HOME and KICAD_DOCUMENTS_HOME under target/, never the person's KiCad folders. Seed kicad-parts-fbc2.
